description: This file defines a static class 'MusicApi' in the namespace 'songs_api_backend.Endpoints' that registers multiple REST API endpoints related to music data such as songs, artists, and genres. It utilizes ASP.NET Core minimal APIs to define GET endpoints for listing and retrieving individual entities, supporting features like pagination, filtering, and inclusion of related data.

classes.name: MusicApi
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods to register music-related API endpoints under the /api path, including endpoints for songs, artists, and genres, supporting operations such as listing, detail retrieval, and nested resource listings.

methods.name: MapMusicApi
methods.description: Registers all music API endpoints under the provided endpoint route builder, grouping endpoints for songs, artists, and genres.

methods.name: MapSongs
methods.description: Defines endpoints related to songs, including listing songs with optional filters and retrieving details of a specific song by ID.

methods.name: MapArtists
methods.description: Defines endpoints related to artists, including listing artists, retrieving details by ID, and listing songs by a specific artist.

methods.name: MapGenres
methods.description: Defines endpoints related to genres, including listing genres, retrieving details by ID, and listing songs by genre.
